title: Unify Space Collection Artifact Workflow Architecture
description:
Unify the fragmented s architecture into: space (atelier/studio/archive, private/public) -> collection (folder tree of artifacts, zip import/export) -> artifact (draft/asset, four grammars: pack/dsl/op-binary/op-text, diffs+backwards ops) -> workflow (non-destructive app pipeline, collection in/out) -> run (readonly fixed-input record) -> automation (event-triggered run). Users: author (rw) / spectator (ro). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-final-goal-for-jolly-spindle.md. Executed in waves W0-W8 by a workforce of agents:
W0 unbreak (imperative-text OperatorInfo.module regression, wires numeric round-trip) + baseline.
W1 grammar engine v2 (LanguageSpec, DslDiff derive, DiffCodec supertrait applied to all 42 diff types, dsl_registry skeleton, new policy allowlists).
W2 new 🪐️space kernel crate (SpaceProjection/CollectionProjection + ops/diffs/reconcile/roles/kinds/visibility/laws) + framework artifact derives + wire/merge kill (delete hand codecs, delete vcs::absorb_diff, route protocol_crdt merge).
W3 the inversion: dissolve os-core OsProjection/OsOperation into 🔁️workflow crate's WorkflowDocument/WorkflowOperation + new RunDocument/AutomationDocument schemas; os-core SpaceCatalog rewritten around the s.space manifest; delete OsWorkflowVfs and create_ephemeral_os_space.
W4 storage/zip (SpaceBundle -> canonical space layout, zip import/export), hub identity (SpaceRole Author/Spectator, SpaceKind/Visibility, delete NodeRecord/VFS, fix postgres hub_studio* DDL vs hub_space* code mismatch, wire db/security authz), DSL hand-rolled-to-derive conversion per plugin family.
W5 non-destructive SpaceRunner rework (SnapshotReader/RunSink/RunContext, sealed runs), DraftCatalog (temp://draft/, TTL, promote/demote), remaining typed Command enums (kill SetDocumentOperation<D> bridge).
W6 AutomationDocument dispatcher in run daemon (--serve, watchers/cron/webhook, event-fingerprint idempotency), space_catalogue() union, diff grammar quality pass for all 42 diff types.
W7 missing fixtures/stubs (architect + 16 norm apps), fixture-sweep law extensions, space app UI (collection browser, workflow bindings inspector, run browser, automation editor, draft shelf).
W8 naming sweep, dsl_registry completeness assertion, delete unconsumed family kits, final gate (all 5 policy allowlists empty, cargo test --workspace, bun script.ts verify, headless os run e2e with cache-hit re-run and automation dedupe).
Repo rules: single lib.rs per crate with regions, extend existing files/tests only, no git-modifying commands, no worktrees, bun+nx, scripts only in script.ts.
